---
format:
  pdf:
    output-file: 04-research-strategy.pdf
    number-sections: true
    top-level-division: section
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        \usepackage{titlesec}
        \setcounter{secnumdepth}{3}
        \titleformat{\subsection}
          {\bfseries\large\color{heading}}
          {\Alph{subsection}.}
          {0.5em}{\MakeUppercase}
          [{\color{heading}\vspace{-0.5ex}\titlerule[1pt]}]
        \renewcommand{\thesubsection}{\Alph{subsection}}
        \titleformat{\subsubsection}
          {\bfseries\normalsize\color{heading}}
          {\thesubsection\arabic{subsubsection}.}
          {0.5em}{}
        \renewcommand{\thesubsubsection}{\thesubsection\arabic{subsubsection}}
        \makeatletter
        \@addtoreset{subsubsection}{subsection}
        \makeatother
        \titlespacing*{\subsection}{0pt}{1.1ex}{0.5ex}
        \titlespacing*{\subsubsection}{0pt}{2pt}{2pt}
        \setlength{\parskip}{4pt}

        % --- Figures -------------------------------------------------------
        \usepackage{float}
        \usepackage{wrapfig}
        \usepackage{caption}
        \renewcommand{\figurename}{Fig.}
        \captionsetup{font=footnotesize, labelfont={bf, footnotesize}}
        \captionsetup[figure]{skip=2pt}
        % Tighten full-width figure-to-text spacing (does not affect wrapfigure).
        \setlength{\textfloatsep}{6pt plus 2pt minus 2pt}

        % \rswrap{side}{width}{path}{caption}
        %   side  : r | l  (or R | L to allow the float to move)
        %   width : e.g. 3.05in — used for BOTH the wrap column and the image
        % Text-wrapped figure with no surrounding whitespace. This is the single
        % biggest page-saver available; prefer it over a full-width float
        % whenever the figure is narrower than the text block.
        % NOTE: wrapfigure is LaTeX-only and vanishes from DOCX. Always pair it
        % with a .content-visible when-format="docx" fallback — see Fig. 1 below.
        \newcommand{\rswrap}[4]{%
          \setlength{\columnsep}{6pt}%
          \setlength{\intextsep}{0pt}%
          \begin{wrapfigure}{#1}{#2}
          \centering
          \includegraphics[width=#2]{#3}
          \caption{#4}
          \end{wrapfigure}%
        }
  docx:
    output-file: 04-research-strategy.docx
    filters:
      # Word has no \Alph{subsection}; this restores the A./B./C. lettering.
      - ../../filters/section-letters.lua
---
